method.method_draft: Enumerate the non-hydrogen bonds visible in the image: Nuc–C, C–R1, C–R2, left C–middle C, middle C–R3, middle C=right C, right C–O−, and right C–Y. Do not count curved arrows or any bond involving H. The enumeration gives 8 bonds.
